system.description: Worship of Chaos as a whole; its faithful are natural Chaos leaders, at odds with no god but Malal, and face lighter demands while taking care not to offend any power.
system.summary: Worship of Chaos as a whole; its faithful are natural Chaos leaders, at odds with no god but Malal, and face lighter demands while taking care not to offend any power.
commandments: Push for what ought to happen rather than guarding against what might.
Reject artifice and imposed structure; prefer what is raw and honest.
Trust feelings over things seen or touched; seek guidance within yourself.
Live now, since tomorrow is uncertain and rewards may never come.
Judge the world by your own experience, not by causes you do not care about.

cults.name: The Black Legion
cults.summary: A union-like Chaos coalition that labors to make the rival gods' followers cooperate; entry needs an insider sponsor and proven effort.

cults.name: The Word Bearers
cults.summary: Zealous missionaries who conquer communities for Chaos, offer conversion or death, then hold them with political and military force.
